refused_values.applies_to: every string anywhere in a module
refused_values.why: a profile is a settings file and never carries a credential

site.description: short site id used in session names, e.g. wayne

submit_host.description: login node the scheduler client runs on

bin_dir.description: scheduler client directory, when not on PATH

partition_cpu.description: CPU partition for interactive and test work

partitions_gpu.description: GPU partitions, in order of preference

account.description: allocation account, when the site needs one

max_walltime.description: longest wall time the CPU partition accepts

node_tmp.description: node-local temp pattern; $USER and $SLURM_JOB_ID/$HPCW_JOB_ID expand in the job

node_tmp_var.description: variable that names node-local temp when the site sets one (SLURM_TMPDIR, L_SCRATCH); empty = none trusted

tmpdir_is_node_local.description: whether $TMPDIR may be trusted as node-local (false on Wayne State: it is CephFS)

ipc_dir.description: where sockets and pipes go (never a swept /tmp)

shared_state_dir.description: shared storage for run directories; $HOME and $USER expand

shared_install.description: the lab's shared copy of the framework (an absolute directory with bin/, lib/, jobs/, profiles/, VERSION; usually a `current` link to a numbered directory); `hpcworker install --shared` uses it and copies no code into the home; empty = none

runtime_module.description: module to load for the runtime, if any

runtime_bin.description: absolute path of the runtime binary, when known

claude_bin.description: path of the claude executable as seen inside the container

binds.description: bind mounts for the container; $HOME and $USER expand

claude_config_dir.description: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR of the student's own Claude Code login; the framework reads two booleans from its .claude.json (remoteDialogSeen, the workspace's hasTrustDialogAccepted) and nothing else

consent_markers.description: fallback marker files whose presence records the student's Remote Control consent when Claude Code has not recorded it itself

ood_shell_host.description: host the portal's Shell app opens

ood_rnode_enabled.description: probed: is the /rnode/ reverse proxy on

ood_auth.description: how the portal signs in (a hint for the extension's Details; the extension tests the channel itself)

vpn_required.description: portal and login node need the VPN

vpn_portal.description: the VPN portal address a student types into the VPN app (protect.wayne.edu)

vpn_help_url.description: the university's page on setting up the VPN (https)

grid_account_help_url.description: the university's page on getting a cluster account (https)

grid_2fa_help_url.description: the university's page on setting up the cluster's two-factor code for a password sign-in (https)

ssh_host.description: the login node's public ssh name, for Beethoven's ssh path (grid.wayne.edu); empty = no ssh path

ssh_host_key.description: ssh_host's host key fingerprint as ssh-keygen -l prints it (SHA256:...); Beethoven refuses any other key

ssh_relay.description: a relay Beethoven may use to reach ssh_host (a wss:// or https:// address), or null for none

browser_key_days.description: days a browser key's line stays valid; past them the gate removes it (null = no expiry)

session_title.description: the Remote Control session title a worker asks for ("Wayne State grid"; "<title> · <name>" for a worker not named worker); empty = "Grid worker"

login_abandon_s.description: seconds a worker job waits for the Claude sign-in before it stops itself and queues no successor (0 = never)

restricted.description: no worker may start on this site's accounts (hpcworker connect refuses)

restricted_workspaces.description: worker names that may not start ("*" for all); hpcworker connect refuses them

xdg_runtime_fix.description: point XDG_RUNTIME_DIR at ipc_dir/$USER/xdg for Claude Code's bash tool

scheduler_in_worker.description: bind the host's scheduler client into the worker's container so Claude Code there can submit and watch jobs (Slurm with apptainer or singularity only; the binds were measured at Wayne State)

home_filesystem.description: panfs, lustre, gpfs, nfs, cephfs...: parallel homes want SIF over sandbox
